checks.detail: Web and native package authorities identify 5.2.0.
The authoritative roadmap and candidate status retain the complete 5.2 contract.
Visual graphs are first-class assets and valid Script2D references.
Graph Editor exposes every specified foundation interaction.
Script2D accepts graphs and edits typed Boolean/number/String/Vec2/Entity/Resource/Data overrides.
Assets can create, inspect and open visual graphs.
Visual graphs compile before entering the existing gameplay sandbox and command model.
Graph editor chrome is present in English, German and Chinese.
User workflow and stable asset format are documented.
The published graph verification command exists and checks every graph through parse, canonical round-trip, compile and static script validation.
Graph serialization is canonical and round-trips byte-for-byte.
A graph compiles into statically valid Rhai API v2 source.
Every Rhai API v2 entry generates one structurally correct graph node.
Typed values, explicit conversions, branching, bounded loops and reroutes are cataloged.
Invalid type and unbounded cycle graphs are rejected before play.
The compiler validates a 1,000-node graph within the local one-second responsiveness budget.
Localized presentation text does not alter stable UUID identity or prevent canonical serialization.
